name: spec-review
description: For a planner before its plan is approved, and for a replay of an archived spec: the spec-review skill, which has two fresh, read-only reader agents read a task's spec.md and tickets in parallel, one as a stranger who paraphrases them and one as the builder who checks each ticket against the code, and writes their findings to spec-review.md for the spec's author to sort. For every delivering builder, whose launch team-worker adds the toolkit to: the claims-check skill, which has one fresh, read-only reader agent check each sentence the branch adds or changes in docs, comments, headers, help text and the PR body against the code at its head, and writes its findings to claims-check.md for the builder to fix, cut or answer. No MCP server, hook or script.
